scope: Supplemental statistical sensitivity on fixed patient-isolated out-of-fold diagnostic-label predictions; not future-event or intervention-effect validation

threshold_grid.selection: outcome-agnostic numerical grid, not clinically recommended cutoffs

decision_curve_estimand: Admission-weighted for MIMIC; patient-weighted for China, under original diagnostic labels and source cohort filters

nri_comparison.rationale: Distinct models trained on identical outer-training patients and tested on identical independent outer-test patients; no proxy score or outcome-as-predictor substitution
nri_comparison.ties: exact equal probabilities or same decision category contribute zero
nri_comparison.categorical: Two-category NRI at each numerical threshold; report positive-label and negative-label components separately
nri_comparison.interpretation: Exploratory reclassification of observed binary diagnostic labels, sensitive to probability calibration; not a prospective risk horizon, clinical threshold endorsement, efficacy or clinical panel validation

bootstrap.sampling_unit: patient, with replacement, retaining all MIMIC admissions and patient multiplicity
bootstrap.uncertainty: Conditional on existing OOF predictions and splits; does not include model refitting, label error, temporal leakage or full cross-validation training dependence

source_validation: Check frozen prediction hashes against completed independent saved-model replay; independently recheck role separation and fold mapping
privacy: Only aggregate statistics exported; no patient identifiers, row-level probabilities, or patient-level clinical data in logs or reports
remaining_requirements: Clinical action and harms/benefits have not been specified
Clinically acceptable thresholds have not been established
Negative-label ascertainment and event-before-predictor timing remain unvalidated
Prospective or interventional utility is not demonstrated
Historical same-OOF isotonic DCA/NRI is not validated by these new results

method_sources.title: Vickers and Elkin (2006), Decision curve analysis: a novel method for evaluating prediction models
Vickers et al. (2023), Decision curve analysis: confidence intervals and hypothesis testing for net benefit
method_sources.use: Paired differences versus default strategies and uncertainty interpretation

method_sources.title: Pencina, D'Agostino and Steyerberg (2011), Extensions of net reclassification improvement calculations to measure usefulness of new biomarkers
method_sources.use: NRI formula and separate event/non-event components
